news.summary: Jio Platforms’ IPO was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening, with demand led by qualified institutional buyers. Eligible Reliance Industries shareholders can apply through a reserved quota of nearly ₹2,500 crore. The IPO is a fresh issue of 27 crore shares, priced at ₹1,065–1,119 each.

news.title: India Cements share price jumps 8%| A trend reversal or just a relief rally? Experts weigh in; check key levels to watch
news.summary: India Cements shares rose nearly 8% after the company announced plans to invest over ₹20 cr for a 3.62% stake in Zenataris Renewable Energy. The project will supply 11 MW of renewable power to its cement plants. The move follows sharply higher quarterly profit and a 16.2% increase in sales volume.
